title: CLARiTy: A Vision Transformer for Multi-Label Classification and Weakly-Supervised Localization of Chest X-ray Pathologies
abstract: arXiv:2512.16700v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The interpretation of chest X-rays poses significant challenges in achieving accurate multi-label pathology classification and spatial localization. These tasks demand different annotation granularities but are constrained by the scarcity of region-level (dense) annotations. We introduce CLARiTy (Class Localizing and Attention Refining Image Transformer), a vision transformer-based model for joint multi-label classification and weakly-supervised localization of thoracic pathologies. CLARiTy employs multiple class-specific tokens to generate discriminative attention maps and a SegmentCAM module for foreground segmentation and background suppression using explicit anatomical priors. Trained on image-level labels from the NIH ChestXray14 dataset, it leverages distillation from a ConvNeXtV2 teacher for efficiency. translated_title: CLARiTy：一种用于胸部X光病理多标签分类与弱监督定位的视觉Transformer
translated_abstract: 胸部X光的判读在实现准确的多标签病理分类和空间定位方面面临重大挑战。这些任务需要不同的标注粒度，但受限于区域级（密集）标注的稀缺性。我们提出了CLARiTy（Class Localizing and Attention Refining Image Transformer，类别定位与注意力精炼图像Transformer），这是一种基于视觉Transformer的模型，用于胸部病理的联合多标签分类与弱监督定位。CLARiTy采用多个类别特定token来生成具有判别力的注意力图，并通过SegmentCAM模块借助显式的解剖学先验进行前景分割与背景抑制。该模型在NIH ChestXray14数据集的图像级标签上训练，并利用来自ConvNeXtV2教师模型的知识蒸馏以提升效率。定位热力图通过OneBox转换为边界框，OneBox是一种滞后门控提取器，其参数经过校准……
tldr: 提出CLARiTy视觉Transformer模型，利用类别特定token、SegmentCAM模块和OneBox边界框提取器，仅凭图像级标签即可实现胸部X光病理的联合多标签分类与弱监督定位。
en_tdlr: CLARiTy, a vision transformer leveraging class-specific tokens, a SegmentCAM module, and a OneBox bounding-box extractor, achieves joint multi-label classification and weakly-supervised localization of chest X-ray pathologies using only image-level labels.
